description: Look up a fundamental physical constant by name, symbol, or common alias. Returns the CODATA 2022 value, SI unit expression, relative standard uncertainty, and a short description. Recognizes common names and symbols — "speed of light", "c", "Avogadro's number", "N_A", "Planck", "h", "Boltzmann", "k_B" all resolve correctly. Fuzzy matching returns the closest match plus alternatives.

query.description: Constant name, symbol, or common alias (e.g., "speed of light", "c", "Avogadro", "N_A", "Planck constant", "h").

name: ref_constant_lookup

codata_id.description: CODATA identifier string, or null if not in CODATA registry.

description.description: Short description of the constant and its significance.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No constant matched the query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exact.description: True when the constant has an exact defined value (no experimental uncertainty).

match_strategy.description: How this constant was matched: exact_symbol = case-sensitive symbol hit (e.g. "G"), exact_name = exact alias/name match, fuzzy = partial or contains match. fuzzy signals the query was imprecise and the result is the closest candidate.

related.description: Related constants that also matched the query.

items.description: A related constant that also matched the query.

uncertainty.description: Absolute standard uncertainty in SI units. Null for exactly-defined constants.

uncertainty_relative.description: Relative standard uncertainty or "exact (defined)" for exact values.

title: Physical Constant Lookup
